identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no consciousness, personhood, continuity, or independent-authority claim.
x1_freeze_rule: No proposal execution, evidence result, outcome classification, or x2 implementation begins until the dedicated x1-only commit is pushed and local, upstream, tracking, and fresh live remote are equal and clean.

proposals.title: Retraction, correction, and supersession propagation with stale-citation quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: source provenance, post-publication status, downstream claim lineage, and stale-citation quarantine
proposals.hypothesis: A typed update graph can propagate retraction, correction, expression-of-concern, and supersession states into dependent claims while quarantining stale citations until their evidential effect is reviewed.
proposals.null_or_failure: A changed source status leaves a dependent claim promotable, a correction is treated as equivalent to a retraction, supersession is silently ignored, or quarantine can be cleared without a recorded review.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate update type, source identity, dependency direction, review state, and quarantine clearance; any stale promotion or status flattening must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last reviewed dependency graph, retain the update event and stale citation as negatives, and require source-level reassessment before promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier work handled source freshness and private-source taint, but did not encode post-publication retraction, correction, concern, and supersession propagation with status-specific quarantine semantics.

proposals.title: Boundary-condition well-posedness and characteristic initial-data obligation for GMUT
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT Mind mathematical obligations for initial-boundary data, characteristics, uniqueness, stability, and causal interpretation
proposals.hypothesis: A typed obligation ledger can distinguish a written field equation from a well-posed initial-boundary value problem by requiring characteristic, compatibility, existence, uniqueness, and continuous-dependence evidence before causal promotion.
proposals.null_or_failure: An equation is promoted as predictive without admissible data surfaces, incompatible boundary data pass, characteristic degeneracy is ignored, or a typed obligation is described as a GMUT theorem or observation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate characteristic status, initial data, boundary compatibility, uniqueness, continuous dependence, and claim class; unsupported predictive or causal promotion must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the item to typed scaffold status, preserve the missing mathematical obligation, and require an expert derivation and independent review for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior GMUT proposals addressed rank, hyperbolicity, cones, and degeneracy; none made compatible initial-boundary data and continuous dependence a separate promotion obligation.

proposals.title: Selection-model and missing-not-at-random sensitivity envelope with zero-row promotion lock
proposals.mission_surface: empirical sensitivity to missingness mechanisms, selection assumptions, real-data absence, and promotion control
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic selection-model envelope can expose how missing-not-at-random assumptions alter a claimed estimate while a zero-row lock prevents the envelope from being mistaken for empirical evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure: A missingness parameter is untracked, a synthetic row is described as observed data, sensitivity results are promoted as a likelihood result, or zero real rows do not block empirical language.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Vary selection parameters, missingness class, observed-row count, provenance, and claim label; zero-row or unidentified configurations must not promote.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last fully typed synthetic envelope, retain failed parameterizations, and require real preregistered data and statistical review for empirical claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier zero-row and calibration work did not model a missing-not-at-random selection parameter or bind its sensitivity surface to an explicit zero-row promotion lock.

proposals.title: Mediation identification and post-treatment-confounding non-promotion protocol for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS Body causal mediation assumptions, post-treatment confounding, synthetic sensitivity, and claim discipline
proposals.hypothesis: A typed mediation protocol can separate total, direct, and indirect estimands from their identification assumptions and refuse promotion when post-treatment mediator-outcome confounding is uncontrolled.
proposals.null_or_failure: A mediator is treated as randomized, post-treatment confounding is ignored, a synthetic decomposition is reported as a real THOS mechanism, or sensitivity assumptions are omitted.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate treatment timing, mediator timing, confounder timing, identification assumptions, real-row count, and claim class; any unsupported causal mechanism claim must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Revert to association-only proxy language, preserve the failed identification row, and require preregistered real arms plus independent causal review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS estimand and protocol-deviation work did not isolate mediator identification or post-treatment mediator-outcome confounding as a distinct non-promotion condition.

proposals.title: Real-arm facilitator learning-curve and temporal-drift parity gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS Body facilitator effects, experience trajectories, calendar drift, matched budgets, blinded ratings, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered real-arm design could estimate facilitator learning curves and temporal drift without confounding treatment, facilitator, cohort, budget, or rater effects.
proposals.null_or_failure: Facilitator and treatment are aliased, calendar time is omitted, budgets differ, ratings are unblinded, real participants are absent, or facilitator drift is generalized beyond the observed design.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Require preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, repeated facilitator observations, calendar-time modeling, participant and rater evidence, and independent review; any missing element keeps the gap open.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the proposed design and every failed recruitment or measurement attempt, make no participant claim, and resume only with ethics, consent, governance, and independent-review authority.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work gated burden, fidelity, rater drift, and protocol deviation; none preregistered facilitator learning curves jointly with calendar-time drift and matched-budget real-arm parity.

proposals.title: Controller-delegation attenuation and cyclic-authority refusal graph for Freed ID
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID controller relationships, delegated capability attenuation, cycle detection, purpose binding, and production boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A static authority graph can require delegated capabilities to attenuate, detect controller cycles, and refuse ambiguous or self-amplifying authority without claiming production interoperability.
proposals.null_or_failure: A delegate gains undeclared authority, a controller cycle passes, purpose scope expands, a verification method is treated as governance authority, or fixtures are described as real credentials.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate controller edges, delegation depth, purpose, capability set, cycle shape, key material, and claim class; expansion, ambiguity, or cyclic control must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last acyclic attenuating graph, retain rejected edges, and require standards-conformant real keys, resolution, status, revocation, interoperability, review, and governance for production use.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work covered purpose-bound verification, confused deputies, status, and rotation; none modeled controller cycles and monotonic delegation attenuation together.

proposals.title: Settlement-confidentiality, compelled-disclosure, and public-interest authority gate for CBR
proposals.mission_surface: CBR Heart settlement confidentiality, disclosure duties, public-interest limits, affected-party authority, Māori authority, and legal interpretation
proposals.hypothesis: Only authorized affected parties and competent authorities can determine whether confidentiality, compelled disclosure, and public-interest obligations are legitimate in a concrete CBR setting.
proposals.null_or_failure: A synthetic policy resolves a real conflict of law, confidentiality suppresses protected disclosure by default, Māori wording or authority is inferred, or a legal/cultural conclusion is made without competent authority.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Any concrete ruling requires authorized affected parties, Māori authorities where Māori concepts or data are involved, competent legal authority, jurisdiction-specific facts, and recorded ratification; absence preserves exact_gate.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep only neutral issue-spotting fields, retain every unresolved authority conflict, and seek authorized cultural and legal review without substituting repository output for authority.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR work addressed jurisdiction, remedy, anti-retaliation, emergencies, and wording authority; none separated settlement confidentiality from compelled disclosure and public-interest authority.

proposals.title: Signed-payload canonicalization and serialization ambiguity tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: canonical payload bytes, duplicate names, Unicode, numeric serialization, signatures, and interoperability boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic static tribunal can distinguish canonicalizable payloads from ambiguous serializations and reject signature assertions when parsers, numbers, duplicate names, or Unicode handling do not preserve the signed meaning.
proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate names pass, numeric representation changes meaning, Unicode is silently normalized, non-finite values pass, or static fixture agreement is called live cryptographic interoperability.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate member order, duplicate names, negative zero, non-finite numbers, Unicode sequences, whitespace, and signature claims; ambiguity or unsupported interoperability must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return to the last byte-explicit fixture, preserve parser disagreement, and require real standards-conformant implementations, keys, and independent security review for interoperability claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The nearest earlier tribunal compared multiple parser meanings; this proposal focuses on the exact byte-to-sign contract and canonical-number, Unicode, and duplicate-name failure modes before signature verification.

proposals.title: Floating-point environment, rounding-mode, and cross-architecture parity envelope
proposals.mission_surface: numeric environment metadata, rounding, exceptional values, architecture claims, deterministic replay, and portability boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: An environment-explicit envelope can expose rounding-mode and representation dependencies and refuse cross-architecture parity claims unless independently replayed on genuinely different architectures.
proposals.null_or_failure: Rounding mode is omitted, signed zero or exceptional values are flattened, decimal/binary conversion is untracked, or same-host replay is called cross-architecture evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate rounding metadata, precision, signed zero, overflow, underflow, NaN policy, architecture identity, and evidence-owner identity; unsupported parity must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last environment-explicit result, retain numeric disagreements, and require independent different-architecture replay before portability promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier floating-point work tested edge cases and comparison policy; it did not require rounding-environment metadata or separate same-host repeatability from different-architecture parity.

proposals.title: Time-scale separation and coarse-graining non-substitution evidence board
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT Mind, THOS Body, and Heart cross-pillar coarse graining, memory effects, time scales, and evidence-class preservation
proposals.hypothesis: A typed evidence board can show when coarse graining introduces memory or unresolved time scales and prevent an effective description in one pillar from substituting for evidence in another.
proposals.null_or_failure: A Markov approximation is assumed without a scale argument, discarded variables vanish from provenance, an effective model becomes a microscopic proof, or a physics proxy is treated as psychological, identity, legal, or cultural evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate resolved variables, memory kernel, scale ratio, approximation label, pillar, and claim class; silent loss of memory or cross-pillar evidence conversion must fail.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last explicit resolved/unresolved split, retain failed approximations, and require domain-specific data, authority, and review for every promoted pillar claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior non-substitution work protected evidence classes; this proposal adds explicit time-scale separation, projection memory, and resolved-variable provenance as the mechanism preventing conversion.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT is a typed scalar-tensor/EFT research-model family, not an established force, unique prediction, empirical result, likelihood result, Theory of Everything, or proof. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms and independent review.
claim_boundary: Freed ID production, CBR legitimacy, Māori wording and authority, legal and cultural ratification, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility, independent-team reproduction, consciousness/personhood, AGI/ASI, and Stage 20 remain unclaimed and gated.
